EmailTemplate.name: Batch Monitoring Email Notification Deleted Scheduler
EmailTemplate.subject: 'The Scheduler has been removed : ' +{!espy__Batch_Monitoring__c.Name}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi Team,
The Scheduled batch {!espy__Batch_Monitoring__c.Name} has been deleted. Kindly look into the issue.
To Reschedule the scheduler , Kindly follow the below steps :
1. Login to Salesforce 2. Go to Developer Console , Open Asynchronous window 3. Execute the below command. system.schedule({!espy__Batch_Monitoring__c.Name},{!espy__Batch_Monitoring__c.espy__CronExpression__c},new {!espy__Batch_Monitoring__c.Name}());
Regards Support Team.
